name: Home Assistant Control
description: Gives MoaBot a bounded set of Home Assistant service-call actions (Music Assistant playback, satellite volume) so voice requests can act, not just observe. Deliberately scoped, not a generic call-any-service passthrough.

baseUrl.description: Home Assistant base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.108:8123 (REST API, not the WebSocket URL).

defaultMediaPlayerEntityId.description: The Music-Assistant-owned media_player entity to target by default (shared by both tools) — NOT the native ESPHome/Voice-PE entity (e.g. media_player.home_assistant_voice_0aacc1, not ..._media_player); music_assistant.play_media's target schema only accepts entities from the music_assistant integration itself, and it's also the entity whose volume_level attribute actually reflects active playback.

musicAssistantConfigEntryId.description: HA config_entries entry_id for the Music Assistant integration instance, required by music_assistant.search (GET /api/config/config_entries/entry, filter domain=music_assistant).

sleepTimerEntityId.description: The timer helper entity this tool starts/cancels, e.g. timer.sleep_timer. Defined in HA's configuration.yaml (restore: true so it survives a restart); a separate HA automation handles the actual timer.finished -> media_player.media_pause step, not this plugin.
